definitions.gloss: throughout the world, all over the world
definitions.explanation: In every part of the world; worldwide.

examples.japanese: この{歌|うた}は{世界中|せかいじゅう}で{人気|にんき}がある。
examples.english: This song is popular all over the world.

examples.japanese: {世界中|せかいじゅう}を{旅|たび}したい。
examples.english: I want to travel around the world.

examples.japanese: {世界中|せかいじゅう}の{人|ひと}がこのニュースを{知|し}っている。
examples.english: People all over the world know about this news.

notes:
{世界中|せかいじゅう} means all over the world or worldwide. It emphasizes that something covers or applies to the entire globe.

ETYMOLOGY:
{世界|せかい} (world) + {中|じゅう} (throughout, all over).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {世界中|せかいじゅう}で: all over the world (location)
- {世界中|せかいじゅう}の〜: ~ from all over the world (modifier)
- {世界中|せかいじゅう}を{旅|たび}する: to travel around the world
- {世界中|せかいじゅう}に{知|し}られている: known worldwide

SIMILAR 〜{中|じゅう} COMPOUNDS:
- {日本中|にほんじゅう}: throughout Japan
- {町中|まちじゅう}: throughout the town
- {家中|いえじゅう}: throughout the house
- {一日中|いちにちじゅう}: all day long

NOTE ON {中|じゅう} vs. {中|ちゅう}:
The suffix {中|じゅう} means "throughout" (spatial or temporal). It is different from {中|ちゅう}, which means "in the middle of" or "during" (e.g., {会議中|かいぎちゅう}, during a meeting).
